query:
SELECT id, client_name, value, status, type, description, due_date, paid_date, amount_paid
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_id = 2850001
  AND (type = 'quota_sale' OR description LIKE '%Pix recebido%')
ORDER BY due_date DESC
LIMIT 10
